protocol: Two independent geometries, seven forces, blank and crossing-stroke canvases; no artwork targets

model_configuration.notes: General refinement from the 1107014 symmetric objective: stable 2ms brush contact, 2000 random self-play transitions, unchanged UNet/training schedule, RGB-supported thin-region PCA/RANSAC, learned seed ranking, Appendix-B footprint/disk colour sampling. Shared palette and parameters for all targets; no target action, task-specific colour subset, or reference prefix fed as the observed state.

original.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations.

stable.notes: Paper robot family, 18x21 inch canvas, 24 wells, short 50 mm brush and Fig. A1 mount structure. Unpublished assembly dimensions estimated locally. Axial spring brush and continuous height-feedback force servo are simulation approximations. General stability refinement: brush penalty-contact relaxation 20 ms instead of 6 ms. Original timestep, controller period, axial spring, servo and paint deposition retained. This is a local numerical contact choice, not a paper hardware parameter.
